=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1470-1604 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The new gate `[ "${release_blocker_baseline_read}" = "true" ] || return 0` at line 1470 in release_blocker_check_cycle_stale suppresses every skip between guard 3 and guard 4, including the persistent `base_not_ancestor` skip on `heads/stable` (line 587). As a result, a stuck stable branch that has diverged from main (#7888) never produces a `cycle_stale` report.
  WHY: release_blocker_on_skip marks `base_not_ancestor` as relevant, but `release_blocker_baseline_read=true` is only set at line 1604, after guard 4. So the check returns with no report and no log on every daily tick, however long main waits, and the README and header still say only `disabled`, `insufficient_docs`, `cycle_in_flight` and `another_run_active` are excluded. The source said MAJOR, mapped here to high. minimax_minimax-m3 called the same gate correct, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said it blocks the pre-guard-4 window as intended.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:122-173,1313-1327,1440-1442; README.md:286-287 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run added three new log values, `reason=streak_broken` (line 1327), `lookup=cycle_job` (line 1315) and `lookup=untrusted_parse` (line 1441). They are missing from the header comment line 167 (`RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=disabled|payload_invalid|dispatch_denied|guard_unavailable blocker=<r> ...`) and from the README rows for `RELEASE_BLOCKER_CYCLE_SKIP_STREAK` (`lookup=jobs|logs`) and `RELEASE_BLOCKER_UNTRUSTED_HOLD_SECS` (`lookup=untrusted_comments` only).
  WHY: Operators and log-analysis rules that match the documented value set will not recognise these lines, so the log contract drifts from its documentation. The tick decision is not affected. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1475-1481 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The staleness calculation in release_blocker_check_cycle_stale returns 0 when timestamps are unavailable.
  WHY: This fails closed, which is acceptable, but a report is still missed whenever the timestamps are missing. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this concern and dropped it: the clock takes the later of the two times, or falls back to the marker clock, so no false report is possible.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1335-1339 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Using `tail -n 1` to pull the skip reason from job logs in release_blocker_check_skip_streak is fragile.
  WHY: If the log format varies, or the last line is not the skip log, the skip streak could be detected wrongly and a valid reporter trigger missed. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this: `grep -oE` already filters down to matching skip lines before `tail -n 1` runs.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:release_blocker_check_cycle_stale line 1470; guard 3 lines 1577-1582; require_stable_branch_ancestor line 587; line 1604 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `release_blocker_baseline_read` gate blocks every skip between guard 3 and guard 4, including the persistent `base_not_ancestor` skip on `heads/stable` (#7888). Because of that, `cycle_stale` is never reported.
  WHY: The check returns at line 1470 with no report and no log line, while the README and header still list only `disabled`, `insufficient_docs`, `cycle_in_flight` and `another_run_active` as excluded. Suggested fix: `[ "${release_blocker_baseline_read}" = "true" ] || [ "${rb_skip_reason}" != "guard_unavailable" ] || return 0`, plus a test for a stale main with a diverged stable branch that expects one `cycle_stale` report.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:header comment line 167; README.md rows for `RELEASE_BLOCKER_CYCLE_SKIP_STREAK` and `RELEASE_BLOCKER_UNTRUSTED_HOLD_SECS` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `reason=streak_broken`, `lookup=cycle_job` (release_blocker_check_skip_streak) and `lookup=untrusted_parse` (release_blocker_check_untrusted_hold) values are not documented.
  WHY: Operators and log rules matching the documented vocabulary will not recognise these lines, so the log contract drifts. Fix is about 3 lines.
- HARDENING: scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:release_blocker_check_skip_streak `rb_matched` pipeline. The whole cycle job log is scanned with no size cap (at most 9 runs). Put `head -c 5000000` before `tr -d '\r'`. About 1 line changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Notes: rejected gemini's empty-timestamp finding and its `tail -n 1` finding. Found no trust-boundary issue with `gh api --allow-escape-sequences` (matches scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1719 and scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:62; the stub at tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:47-55 skips unknown flags). TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE.
